summary: --- name: Clawdbot description: Use when deploying a self-hosted AI agent gateway, configuring multi-channel messaging (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, iMessage), managing agent workspaces and sessions, building plugins or skills, setting up automation (hooks, cron, webhooks), or troubleshooting gateway operations. metadata: mintlify-proj: clawdbot version: "1.0" --- # OpenClaw Skill Reference ## Product Summary OpenClaw is a self-hosted gateway that connects messaging apps (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, iMessage, and more) to AI agents. The Gateway runs on any OS and manages sessions, routing, tool execution, and channel delivery. Key files: `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json` (config), `~/.openclaw/workspace/` (agent workspace), `~/.openclaw/skills/` (local skills). Primary CLI: `openclaw` with subcommands for setup, config, channels, agents, sessions, and gateway management. See https://docs.openclaw.ai for full documentation.
type: skills
